subject: MSstats external tool in Skyline v2.3.4 re-updated on Oct 14

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: MSstats external tool in Skyline v2.3.4 re-updated on Oct 14
parts:
Dear all users,

First of all, thank you, Vendula, Erik, and Linda, for reporting errors for MSstats external tool in Skyline v2.3.4. Now, fixed v2.3.4 is available in Tool store from Skyline. 

Therefore, if you download the version 2.3.4 from Oct 14, 2014, the error for group comparison is fixed.
If you already downloaded the version 2.3.4 before Oct 14, you can follow the instruction below:
     1. Please download the attached file named 'MSstats_2.3.4.2_external.zip' and save it any folder you want.
     2. In Skyline, Tools > External Tools... . Then, 'External Tools' windows will be pop-up
     3. In menu contents box from External tools windows, remove 3 lines (belows) related with MSstats 
               MSstats\QC
               MSstats\Group Comparision
               MSstats\Design Sample Size
         clike one of them or three of them, then click 'Remove' button on the right.
     4. After removing all three lines in 'Menu contents', then click 'Apply' at the right bottom.
     5. Click 'Add..' button right upside. Then select 'From File...'
     6. Choose the file 'MSstats_2.3.4.2_external.zip' from the folder you saved it.
     7. Then you can see three lines you removed will be generated again in 'Menu content's box. Then click 'Ok' at the bottom.
Then fixed version 2.3.4 of MSstats will be completely installed.
Please let me know if you had any issue for this installation.

--Meena
